**Observation Log:**

[FACT] User is tracking their charity contributions for the year 2023.  
[EVENT] User raised $250 at the "Walk for Cancer" event last Sunday.  
[EVENT] User participated in the "Bake Sale for Education" event, where their team raised $1,380 more than their individual contribution.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered to help calculate the total amount raised so far.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant broke down the contributions: $250 from "Walk for Cancer" and an unknown amount x from "Bake Sale for Education".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant set up an equation to find the user's individual contribution from the "Bake Sale for Education".  
[FACT] User provided that the team's total contribution for the "Bake Sale for Education" was $1,500.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant solved for x, determining the user's individual contribution to the "Bake Sale for Education" was $120.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant calculated the total amount raised so far: $370 ($250 from "Walk for Cancer" + $120 from "Bake Sale for Education").  
[EVENT] User wants to add amounts raised from other charity events to the total.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant asked for amounts raised from the "Gala for the Homeless", "Food Drive", "Polar Bear Plunge", and "Animal Shelter".  
[FACT] User spent $500 on a painting at the "Gala for the Homeless" and paid a ticket price of $100, resulting in no funds raised.  
[FACT] User reported collecting $300 in cash donations at the "Food Drive".  
[FACT] User raised $500 in donations from the "Polar Bear Plunge".  
[FACT] User did not raise any funds from volunteering at the "Animal Shelter".  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant focused on cash amounts for the calculation.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant calculated the total raised so far: $1,170 ($370 + $300 + $500).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted the $600 spent at the "Gala for the Homeless" as a personal contribution.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant calculated the total charitable giving for the year: $1,770 ($1,170 raised + $600 spent).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant offered to help categorize contributions by cause.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant categorized contributions: Education ($120), Healthcare ($250), Homelessness ($600), Food Security ($300), Animal Welfare ($0).  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant noted that the "Polar Bear Plunge" funds might not fit neatly into one category and asked for clarification.
